name: Disneyland Hotel Trader Sam's Enchanted Tiki Bar Tonkotsu Ramen, Kalua Pork Flatbread & Citrus-Free Coconut Mocktail
brandOrRestaurant: Trader Sam's Enchanted Tiki Bar (Disneyland Hotel · Disneyland Resort)
whyItWorks: Trader Sam's shares its kitchen with Tangaroa Terrace—so you can order warm Tonkotsu Ramen, Teriyaki Chicken & White Rice, or Hawaiian Cheeseburger Sliders on the patio, and ask the bartender for a custom **Pineapple-Coconut Cream Mocktail (No Lime/Lemon/Orange Juice!)**.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Almost all menu tiki drinks contain lime, lemon, or orange juice—tell the bartender "strictly no citrus (no lime, lemon, or orange)" and ask for a custom Pineapple Juice + Cream of Coconut smoothie!
watchOuts: CRITICAL CITRUS WARNING: Nearly every standard tiki cocktail/mocktail at Trader Sam's contains lime, lemon, or orange juice—order a custom Pineapple-Coconut blend only
